results.title: San Diego County will stop letting federal immigration agents train at local firing ranges
results.description: A Southern California county will stop letting federal immigration authorities train at a local firing range over concerns about the Trump administration’s crackdown on immigrants. San Diego County supervisors voted 3-2 on Tuesday to end contracts with Immigration and Customs Enforcement and Customs and Border Protection to train at a county-owned facility near the Mexican border and a Navy facility leased by the county. The head of CBP says the move could reduce local staffing as 1,700 officers need to get mandatory training elsewhere, affecting trade and travel on the border.
